known_differences.description: sparse array interface (csr_array, csc_array, etc.) became the recommended API, deprecating sparse matrix classes
scipy.differentiate module introduced with derivative, jacobian, hessian
scipy.interpolate.make_smoothing_spline introduced for automatic smoothing parameter selection
scipy.integrate.cubature introduced as a modern multi-dimensional integration API
scipy.odr deprecated, scheduled for removal in 1.19.0
scipy.signal.ShortTimeFFT class added as modern STFT replacement

threats.description: Ill-conditioned matrices cause catastrophic cancellation in LU/Cholesky/QR decomposition, producing high backward error.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-linalg/src/lib.rs:3737 (solve_with_audit): estimates reciprocal condition number via Hager-Higham 1-norm, checks Oettli-Prager backward error, and falls back from LU to QR/SVD via CASP SolverPortfolio.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return result with LinAlgWarning when condition exceeds threshold and fallback when backward error exceeds ATTEMPT_BACKWARD_ERROR_TOL.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce finite checks, emit SolveCertificate, and record fallback/warning events in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Non-square matrices passed to square-only operations (det, inv, eig), NaN/Inf elements in input matrices, mismatched dimensions in solve(A, B).
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-linalg/src/lib.rs:3737 (solve_with_audit): validates matrix dimensions and element finiteness at entry point.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return LinalgError::ShapeMismatch or SingularMatrix matching SciPy LinAlgError.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Return LinalgError and record AuditAction::FailClosed in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Very large dense matrices (>10000x10000) in O(n^3) decompositions exhaust memory or cause unacceptable runtime in Hardened mode.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-linalg/src/lib.rs:3737 (solve_with_audit): enforces HARDENED_MAX_DIM (10,000) dimension cap in Hardened mode.
threats.strict_mode_response: Proceed without dimension limit (matching SciPy).
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject matrices exceeding HARDENED_MAX_DIM with LinalgError::ResourceExhausted and FailClosed audit record.

threats.description: Integrand singularities (endpoint, interior, or oscillatory) cause adaptive quadrature to subdivide excessively or encounter non-finite evaluations.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/quad.rs:256 (quad): uses adaptive Gauss-Kronrod 15/21-point rules with break points, weighted QUADPACK rules, and non-finite short-circuiting.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return QuadResult with error estimate and convergence flag matching QUADPACK.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce subdivision limit and fail closed on non-finite evaluations.

threats.description: IVP solvers (solve_ivp) encounter stiff systems where explicit methods (RK45) take tiny steps unless implicit Radau/BDF or LSODA is used.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/api.rs:1189 (solve_ivp): supports Radau IIA, BDF, LSODA automatic stiffness switching, and OdeSolverPortfolio expected-loss selection.
threats.strict_mode_response: Terminate when required step size falls below floating-point spacing or switch automatically in LSODA.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Select solver via OdeSolverPortfolio and record step/fallback outcomes in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Local minimizers on non-convex or poorly scaled objectives can stall or encounter non-finite trial steps.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-opt/src/minimize.rs:516 (minimize_with_audit): validates initial state and objective finiteness and provides OptSolverPortfolio expected-loss selection.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return local minimum with OptimizeResult status matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite inputs fail-closed and record decision in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Inconsistent constraint specifications or infeasible linear constraints passed to linprog or constrained minimize.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-opt/src/linprog.rs:204 (linprog): checks bound feasibility and detects infeasible/unbounded linear programs in Phase I.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return status 2 (infeasible) or 3 (unbounded) matching SciPy linprog.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate constraint dimensions and finiteness before optimization.

threats.description: Invalid sparse matrix construction: negative indices, indices exceeding declared shape, or non-monotonic indptr arrays.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-sparse/src/linalg.rs:5861 (spsolve): validates CSR/CSC indptr monotonicity, index bounds, and shape compatibility.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return SparseError on invalid structure or dimension mismatch.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject invalid sparse structure fail-closed and emit FailClosed audit event.

threats.description: Sparse LU factorization or iterative solvers encountering singular matrices or stagnation.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-sparse/src/linalg.rs:6041 (splu): applies partial pivoting with column ordering and detects zero pivots cleanly.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return SparseError::SingularMatrix on zero pivot.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Route through SparseSolverPortfolio and record fallback or FailClosed in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Non-finite values in FFT/DCT/DST inputs corrupting all output frequency bins.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-fft/src/transforms.rs:2235 (fft): rejects NaN/Inf inputs when check_finite or Hardened mode is active.
threats.strict_mode_response: Check finiteness when check_finite flag is set.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite inputs unconditionally with FftError::NonFiniteInput.

threats.description: FFT of prime-length sequences degrading to O(n^2) without Bluestein's algorithm.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-fft/src/transforms.rs:2235 (fft): uses Bluestein chirp-z and Rader algorithms for prime lengths > 61 with cached plans.
threats.strict_mode_response: Proceed with Bluestein's O(n log n) algorithm matching SciPy PocketFFT.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Execute cached Bluestein plan with finite-input validation.

threats.description: Special functions evaluated near branch cuts, poles, or asymptotic boundaries.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-special/src/gamma.rs:165 (gamma): uses region-based series, reflection, and asymptotic expansions with pole detection.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return IEEE NaN/Inf at poles matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject pole/domain errors in Hardened mode and emit FailClosed audit event.

threats.description: Catastrophic cancellation in log(1+x), exp(x)-1, gammaln, and relative entropy for small deltas.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-special/src/gamma.rs:196 (gammaln): provides dedicated log-space and near-zero series kernels (gammaln, log1p, expm1, rel_entr).
threats.strict_mode_response: Evaluate dedicated cancellation-free kernels matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Evaluate cancellation-free kernels with domain and finiteness guards.

threats.description: Distribution CDF/PDF/PPF evaluation at extreme quantiles or nearly-singular covariance matrices.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-stats/src/lib.rs:38242 (pearsonr): uses log-space density evaluations and scale-preserving Cholesky/eigendecomposition in Covariance.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy tail probability and quantile semantics.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite or out-of-domain distribution parameters fail-closed.

threats.description: Statistical tests receiving empty samples, ties, zero variance, or non-finite observations.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-stats/src/lib.rs:36704 (mannwhitneyu): validates sample sizes, applies tie corrections, and checks observation finiteness.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy tie-correction and degenerate-sample handling.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite or insufficient samples fail-closed with FailClosed audit record.

threats.description: High-order IIR filter transfer-function coefficients losing precision compared to cascaded second-order sections (SOS).
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-signal/src/lib.rs:9924 (sosfilt): implements direct ZPK-to-SOS pairing and biquad filtering.
threats.strict_mode_response: Provide both BA and SOS filter representations matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate finite section coefficients and non-zero leading a0.

threats.description: Signal processing functions receiving non-finite samples, empty signals, or invalid cutoff frequencies.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-signal/src/lib.rs:8029 (butter): validates filter order, cutoff bounds in (0, 1), and sample finiteness.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return SignalError matching SciPy ValueError.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject invalid parameters and non-finite inputs fail-closed with FailClosed audit record.

threats.description: Degenerate point configurations in Delaunay triangulation, convex hull, and Procrustes alignment.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-spatial/src/lib.rs:6615 (procrustes): checks degenerate / collinear point sets and rejects oversized predicate dimensions.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return SpatialError on degenerate point configurations matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject degenerate geometry fail-closed and emit FailClosed audit event.

threats.description: KDTree queries in high dimensions (>20) visit many leaf boxes due to the curse of dimensionality.
threats.mitigation: status: undefended — KDTree executes exact branch-and-bound search in arbitrary dimensions without emitting a high-dimension warning.
threats.strict_mode_response: Proceed without warning (matching SciPy cKDTree).
threats.hardened_mode_response: Proceed with exact KDTree search after validating finite coordinates.

threats.description: High-degree polynomial interpolation (Runge's phenomenon) oscillates between nodes unless monotone PCHIP/Akima splines are used.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-interpolate/src/lib.rs:998 (pchip_interpolate): provides monotone piecewise cubic Hermite interpolation alongside barycentric/Krogh polynomial helpers.
threats.strict_mode_response: Evaluate requested interpolator matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate strictly increasing knots and finite values fail-closed.

threats.description: Image processing operations with invalid filter sizes, negative sigma, or mismatched flat buffer lengths.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-ndimage/src/lib.rs:3160 (uniform_filter): validates positive filter sizes, shape products, and boundary mode parameters.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return NdimageError matching SciPy ValueError.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Return NdimageError and emit FailClosed audit record.

threats.description: Malformed or truncated .mat, Matrix Market, WAV, or NetCDF files with inconsistent headers or declared nnz/byte lengths.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-io/src/lib.rs:368 (mmread): validates header banners, coordinate bounds, and declared entry counts before returning.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return IoError::FormatError matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate all header bounds and finiteness fail-closed with FailClosed audit record.

threats.description: Hierarchical clustering linkage on malformed condensed distance vectors or non-finite observation matrices.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-cluster/src/lib.rs:4594 (linkage): validates exact condensed distance length n*(n-1)/2 and finite entries prior to clustering.
threats.strict_mode_response: Reject invalid condensed lengths with ClusterError::InvalidShape.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject invalid lengths and non-finite inputs fail-closed with FailClosed audit record.

threats.description: Sustained solver backward-error drift or non-finite decision signals degrading CASP portfolio reliability.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-runtime/src/eprocess.rs:178 (observe): monitors backward-error failure streams with an anytime-valid Waudby-Smith & Ramdas betting martingale and routes to SVDFallback on alarm.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match calibrated SciPy-compatible LU default when healthy and fallback on alarm.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce Hardened loss matrix and emit FallbackTriggered / FailClosed audit events.

threats.description: Non-finite condition signals in PolicyController::decide biasing action selection toward unsafe fast solvers.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-runtime/src/policy.rs:161 (decide): sanitizes non-finite signals to worst-case risk (1.0) deterministically.
threats.strict_mode_response: Clamp non-finite signal to 1.0 risk.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Clamp non-finite signal to 1.0 risk and select conservative action.

threats.description: Optimization or root-bracketing methods failing to terminate on flat or monotone functions.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-opt/src/bracket.rs:160 (bracket_root): enforces maxiter limit and terminates with converged=false when no bracket exists.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return result with converged=false at maxiter matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce strict evaluation cap and return structured non-convergence status.

threats.description: Restarted GMRES inner tolerance drift causing premature termination before outer residual target is met.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-sparse/src/linalg.rs:9480 (gmres): tightens inner Arnoldi tolerance adaptively across restarts and checks true residual norm.
threats.strict_mode_response: Converge to requested rtol/atol matching SciPy gmres.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Verify true residual and reject non-finite inputs fail-closed.

threats.description: Matrix exponential (expm) and complex factorizations encountering large norms or singular blocks.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-linalg/src/complex.rs:2272 (expm): uses Higham scaling-and-squaring Pade approximants for real and complex matrices.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Pade scaling-and-squaring result matching SciPy linalg.expm.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate finiteness and matrix squareness before Pade evaluation.

threats.description: Broadcasting and slice bounds semantics diverging between Strict NumPy/Array-API clamping and Hardened bounds checking.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-arrayapi/src/broadcast.rs:6 (broadcast_shapes): enforces exact Array API broadcasting rules and mode-aware slice validation.
threats.strict_mode_response: Match Array API broadcasting and slice clamping rules.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject out-of-bounds slices and incompatible shapes fail-closed with FailClosed audit record.

threats.description: Adaptive quadrature or IVP integration with sub-machine-epsilon tolerance causing excessive work.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-integrate/src/validation.rs:337 (validate_tol): clamps rtol below MIN_RTOL (100 * f64::EPSILON) with warning or BoundedRecovery audit record.
threats.strict_mode_response: Clamp rtol to MIN_RTOL with RtolClamped warning matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Clamp rtol to MIN_RTOL and record BoundedRecovery in AuditLedger.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return error listing valid solver method names.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return error and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: None — unknown solver methods are rejected.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject unconditionally with NonFiniteInput and FailClosed audit record.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: Use Strict mode with check_finite=false where supported.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return validation error indicating tolerance must be positive.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return validation error and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: None — negative tolerance is never valid.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return SparseError listing supported formats (CSR, CSC, COO, BSR, LIL, DOK, DIA).
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return SparseError and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
Return ArrayApiError::UnsupportedDType and record FailClosed event.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: None — unsupported dtypes require explicit conversion.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return ShapeMismatch error and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: None — dimension mismatches are always errors.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return IoError::FormatError and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: None — corrupted files cannot be safely processed.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Proceed within host allocation limits (matching SciPy).
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject inputs exceeding HARDENED_MAX_DIM with ResourceExhausted error.
fail_closed_policies.override_mechanism: Use Strict mode for dimensions above HARDENED_MAX_DIM.
